    X, y_encoded, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_encoded
)

scale_pos_weight = class_counts.max() / class_counts

    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    subsample=0.8,

        try:
            pd.to_datetime(X[col])
            datetime_cols.append(col)
        except:

for col in datetime_cols:
    X[col] = pd.to_datetime(X[col], errors='coerce')
    X[col + '_year'] = X[col].dt.year.fillna(0).astype(int)
    X[col + '_month'] = X[col].dt.month.fillna(0).astype(int)
    X[col + '_day'] = X[col].dt.day.fillna(0).astype(int)
    X[col + '_dayofweek'] = X[col].dt.dayofweek.fillna(0).astype(int)
    X[col + '_hour'] = X[col].dt.hour.fillna(0).astype(int)
    X.drop(columns=[col], inplace=True)

# 2. Handle time columns (if any time-only format)
time_cols = []

        try:
            pd.to_datetime(X[col], format='%H:%M:%S')
            time_cols.append(col)
        except:

for col in time_cols:

    X[lat_col + '_abs'] = np.abs(X[lat_col])
